description: This Java class 'ActivityB' is an Android activity demonstrating lifecycle callback methods. It manages UI updates related to activity state changes, interacts with a StatusTracker utility, and provides methods to start other activities or finish itself.

classes.name: ActivityB
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates lifecycle callback methods and UI status updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and updates the status tracker and UI.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles the activity becoming visible, updates status tracker and UI.

methods.name: onRestart
methods.description: Handles the activity being restarted, updates status tracker and UI.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles the activity gaining focus, updates status tracker and UI.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles the activity losing focus, updates status tracker.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Handles the activity no longer visible, updates status tracker.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles the activity being destroyed, updates status tracker.
